capabilities: add Pandoc-style attributes to Markdown elements using curly-brace syntax
assign classes and IDs to paragraphs, headers, tables and table cells
apply attributes to links, lists, code blocks, block quotes and callouts
disambiguation: Not frontmatter or properties editing; it adds inline { attribute } syntax to elements in the note body.
extras: Documentation has moved to an external site; the plugin is in maintenance mode (bug fixes only, no new features) and the README warns that rendering errors may occur, though data loss is not expected.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown syntax has no built-in way to attach HTML-style attributes like classes or IDs to individual elements in a note.
summary: Adds Pandoc-style Markdown attributes (classes, IDs) to elements such as text, headers, tables, links, lists, code blocks and block quotes.
